scripts.dev: SITE_MODE=${SITE_MODE:-preview} concurrently --kill-others --names wallpaper,site "node apps/site/scripts/build-wallpaper-system.mjs --watch" "cd apps/site && ASTRO_DEV_BACKGROUND=0 astro dev --config astro.local.config.mjs --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${SITE_PORT:-4332}"
scripts.preview: export SITE_MODE=${SITE_MODE:-preview}; npm run build && cd apps/site && astro preview --config astro.local.config.mjs --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${SITE_PORT:-4333}
scripts.test: export SITE_MODE=${SITE_MODE:-preview}; vitest run && npm run build && playwright test
